definitions.Tp: projective direction circle R/piZ, total mass pi
definitions.chord: Gamma_theta(u) = p_theta + u e(theta), u in [0,1], the full paired chord
definitions.rho: rho(phi) = sup{|x| : x in union_theta Gamma_theta, arg x = phi}, sup of empty set = 0
definitions.Cap2: Cap2 = (1/2) * upper-Lebesgue-integral over S^1 of rho(phi)^2 dphi
definitions.identity: Cap2 = outer Lebesgue measure of Tri(E) = union_theta conv(0, Gamma_theta)
definitions.normalisation: all capacities are reported divided by pi
definitions.delta: angular defect from antipodality; A B sin(delta) = h and A^2+B^2+2AB cos(delta) = 1

route_ceilings.explanation: near-extremizer values are diagnostics only; explicit legal adversaries determine whether a route survives universally

adversary_endpoint_collapse.family: a = kappa(1-2t)/2, s = gamma t(1-t), gamma = (1+kappa)/2
adversary_endpoint_collapse.verdict: endpoint branch int J -> 0 as kappa -> 1 while the interior-contact branch stays bounded below: any endpoint-only capacity functional collapses

adversary_far_needles.note: m^2 + 1/4 <= M^2 always; the perpendicular far needle has h = m so the elementary triangle bound h/2 takes over

adversary_far_common_center.verdict: pointwise, a.e., essential-inf, quantile, and fixed local-average antipodal floors have best universal constant zero; full-angle average is exactly twice radial capacity

MUT-1-remove-pairing.check: replace the paired chord constraint A^2 + B^2 >= 1/2 by the unpaired endpoint marginal max(A,B) >= 1/2
MUT-1-remove-pairing.gate: sharp constant for the h == 0 class

secondary_finite_cell_witness.note: the rational-seven near-extremizer is pairing-symmetric (its two far-endpoint images nest), so dropping one endpoint family is almost invisible there; the mutation is decisive on the h == 0 class and on the astroid

MUT-2-remove-interior-contacts.check: discard every chord interior and keep only the two chord endpoints; evaluate on a legal endpoint-collapse family

closed_form_cross_check.family: a = kappa(1-2t)/2, s = gamma t(1-t), gamma=(1+kappa)/2

MUT-3-coarsen-one-scale.check: Hall expansion constant lambda_m = min dyadic endpoint expansion
MUT-3-coarsen-one-scale.note: coarsening reports expansion lambda = 0.1439 where the fine scale sees 0.00695; a Hall alternative certified at the coarse scale is not valid at the fine scale

MUT-4-null-fibre-ae-relaxation.check: replace the pointwise fibre constraint rho(arg x) >= |x| by an a.e.-in-phi constraint
MUT-4-null-fibre-ae-relaxation.reason: for h == 0 every chord meets each circle in a two-point set, so every fibre {phi : some chord point has argument phi and radius >= r} is a countable union of singletons per direction; an a.e.-in-phi constraint is satisfied by rho == 0 off a null set and the relaxed infimum is 0, while the true value is >= 1/4

C1_uniform_radial_floor.statement: rho >= c a.e.  =>  Cap2 >= pi c^2
C1_uniform_radial_floor.status: false in general: the origin-crossing radial family Gamma_theta=[T e(theta),(T+1)e(theta)] has rho=0 on an oriented half-circle

C2_antipodal_pair_floor.statement: rho(phi)^2 + rho(phi+pi)^2 >= c  =>  Cap2 >= pi c/2
C2_antipodal_pair_floor.status: REFUTED universally: far common-centre radial hulls have rho(phi)=rho(phi+pi)=0 on a positive-measure interval; the reported near-extremizer value is diagnostic only

C3_hall_carleson_endpoint_expansion.statement: either the paired endpoint image expands by lambda or a compression payment is collected
C3_hall_carleson_endpoint_expansion.status: REFUTED: expansion branch is vacuous on a legal family

C4_radial_sliver_covering.statement: class-scoped: if all needles satisfy m(theta)<=r0, then |{rho >= r}| >= pi*(1-2r)/(1+2r) and the integrated coefficient is 0.0284264 at r0=0
C4_radial_sliver_covering.scope: class-scoped; every selected needle meets B(O,r0)
C4_radial_sliver_covering.status: PROVED (see THEORY.md Theorem A); constant not claimed sharp

no_go.target: paired endpoint image expansion / Hall-Carleson alternative
no_go.why: the endpoint Jacobian J = H^2 - s'H + sH' vanishes identically at kappa = 1, so the whole projective direction circle is mapped by the leading-endpoint argument map onto a single output angle: the expansion branch of any Hall alternative is vacuous on a legal family
